changes.before: This records a practice action and makes no claim about real credential exposure.
changes.after: DUMMY-1234 jaise fictional training-only token ko bina poochhe bolna bhi synthetic disclosure hai. Yeh real credential exposure ya request par agreement establish nahi karta; simulation safely khatam hoti hai.

after.scoring: Record COMPLIED only when committed behavior shows agreement without a dummy value. Verification, disclosure, enrollment and transaction completion remain unscored without their own evidence. Agreement alone earns no independent-verification credit.

after.takeaway: Call par haan aur token batana alag observations hain. Aage koi action lene se pehle apne known channel se verify karein.
